gems.name: ap2_mandate_verifier
gems.info: Framework-independent Ruby SDK for supported AP2 Checkout profiles: Merchant JWT signing, Direct and conditional Mandate issuance and presentation, full verification with immutable Evidence, Checkout Receipts, Direct and conditional Payment Mandates, and Payment Receipts. Adds selective Checkout/Payment, PISP/date constraints opt-in transactional Payment acceptance/idempotency support and explicit bounded JPY/ON_DEMAND quotas and separate long Open UTC-monthly JPY profiles with protected current authority and Root/key continuity. Requires independently trusted application inputs; verification does not grant purchase or payment permission.
